findings.title: Guard test regex misses `docker compose -p <project> ... up` invocations
findings.body: tests/mcp/test_no_legacy_fleet_start_paths.py _FLEET_START_RE only tolerates -f flags between `compose` and `up`. Live unallowlisted fleet-launch scripts evade it: scripts/start.sh:81 and scripts/compose_nuke.sh:35 (both `docker compose -p ... -f compose.yml up -d`). Both remain live legacy launch paths post-merge.

findings.title: dopemux init default MCP startup bypasses `dopemux mcp` and is invisible to the guard test
findings.body: src/dopemux/cli.py _start_mcp_servers_with_progress (called from `dopemux init` at cli.py:2433) builds `docker compose ... up -d --remove-orphans` as a Python list and runs it via subprocess.Popen — structurally undetectable by a line-based regex scan. File untouched by this PR and not flagged as a known gap.

findings.title: install-mcp-servers.sh Docker-MCP install step now a permanent silent no-op
findings.body: scripts/deploy/setup/install-mcp-servers.sh:128 still calls the now-deleted scripts/install-docker-mcp-servers.sh, guarded by an existence check — degrades to skip-with-warning instead of crashing, so the installer's Docker-MCP step silently no-ops after this PR.

findings.title: .github/copilot-instructions.md still presents services/registry.yaml as live authority
findings.body: Untouched by this PR; lines 48/348/356 instruct agents to treat services/registry.yaml as the authoritative port/health source, contradicting the PR's registry-deprecation narrative. Copilot-facing instruction file with AGENTS.md-equivalent behavioral weight.

findings.title: pm-plane-runtime-recovery.md contradicts itself after this PR's edit
findings.body: docs/02-how-to/operations/pm-plane-runtime-recovery.md received the PR's :8000-vs-:7890 scope note, but lines 84-91 in the same file still recommend scripts/start.sh and raw `docker compose -f compose.yml up -d task-orchestrator` under a 'Recommended' heading — contradicting the PR's own AGENTS.md §12.6 rule.

findings.title: P-22 deletion-count phrasing slightly mischaracterizes one file
findings.body: Auditor notes scripts/deploy/setup/install-mcp-servers.sh was modified (reference update), not among the deleted set as a reader might infer from the '14 deleted' summary framing.
